source: Seed list compiled from public advisories: CISA alert on the npm ecosystem compromise (2025-09-23), Checkmarx Zero, Wiz, Unit 42 and Datadog Security Labs write-ups on the Shai-Hulud / Shai-Hulud 2.0 / Mini Shai-Hulud waves and the September 2025 chalk/debug maintainer compromise.
completeness: INCOMPLETE SEED LIST. The published campaigns affected 500-800+ packages across several waves. This file carries a representative subset so the evaluation harness has ground truth out of the box. Extend it with scripts/fetch_iocs.py before quoting any metric.
caveat: Membership means a malicious version of the package was published at some point. It does NOT mean the version resolved in any given scan is malicious.
